evals.prompt: Draw our job flow: API validates a request, rejects invalid input, otherwise queues it; a worker loads, transforms, stores and notifies. Group the worker steps together.
evals.expected_output: Editable Mermaid and clean SVG with the worker boundary and both validation branches. Inspect the image; no art dependency installation.

evals.prompt: Make a sequence diagram: User submits to API, API enqueues to Queue, Queue delivers to Worker, Worker returns a result to API, API reports completion to User.
evals.expected_output: Four participants, five messages, source plus clean SVG. Preserve direction and labels; no canvas, fonts or browser setup.

evals.prompt: Render this flat state Mermaid as a hand-drawn diagram. DESIGN.md says Hand-drawn support: disabled.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the supplied Mermaid. Explain the disabled policy without invoking or installing art and without silently producing a different requested style.

evals.prompt: Make this order state diagram hand-drawn, including its Published --> [*] final marker.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the final marker in source. Explain that art rejects final markers; offer clean SVG without silently removing the marker or claiming art succeeded.

evals.prompt: Show customers placing orders, orders containing items and products identifying items in an ER diagram. Use one-to-many relationships.
evals.expected_output: Four entities and three relationships with cardinality, editable source and inspected clean SVG.
